description: Ministers of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education - Degree Awarding Institute Order S/L Institute of Information Technology (Gurantee) Limited.
categorisation: This gazette notification is about the recognition of a degree program (Bachelor of Science Honours in Psychology) at the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology. While it mentions a minister's name and title, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed ministerial portfolio responsibilities. The content focuses on educational regulations and degree program accreditation, which falls under the Miscellaneous category for educational matters not covered by other specialized types.
